outcome: Help authorised merchants compare price and promotion scenarios that balance value, margin, inventory, competition and policy.
overview: Gulf retailers run promotion calendars — Ramadan baskets, White Friday, back-to-school — that repeat year after year with little evidence of what actually drove incremental sales. This solution builds a governed price and promotion layer from POS, cost, stock, competitor and campaign data, estimates cross-product elasticity and cannibalisation, then compares scenarios inside legal and margin guardrails. Merchants approve every price or promotion action, and each carries its reasoning and approval record before it reaches the pricing or promotion engine. An 8–12 week category pilot back-tests against the incumbent calendar and measures verified incremental contribution against a control, so finance sees evidence rather than correlation.

benefits.text: Increase verified promotional contribution, or cut spend on promotions a controlled test shows are not incremental
benefits.source: Redington Retail catalogue; consistent with published research on promotional effectiveness in grocery and general merchandise
benefits.limits: Basis: hypothesis. Effect size to validate in a controlled test on the customer’s own categories during the pilot — not a guarantee

benefits.text: Protect agreed price-image, margin-floor and legal constraints on every recommended action
benefits.source: Reference design — constraints applied before scenarios are shown, not after approval
benefits.limits: A design property verified in constraint tests; it depends on the customer’s own price rules and legal review being current

benefits.text: Give merchants a reason and an approval record for every price and promotion change
benefits.source: Reference design — merchant approval workflow with scenario reasoning and audit trail
benefits.limits: Explanations cover model drivers and scenario assumptions; value depends on merchant adoption of the workflow

residency: Deployable in-country on local AWS or Azure regions (e.g. UAE, KSA); sales, cost and promotion data remain in the customer tenancy in the reference designs

notFor.situation: No linked price, promotion and cost history at SKU and location level
notFor.why: Elasticity and cannibalisation cannot be estimated from sales alone — the model needs the price and cost that produced them

notFor.situation: No legal or compliance review of pricing practice in the operating market
notFor.why: Price actions carry consumer-law exposure; the design will not recommend what has not been cleared as permissible

notFor.situation: No ability to hold a control group of stores, regions or customers
notFor.why: Incrementality is the whole claim; before-and-after comparison cannot separate a promotion from the season around it

scope:
Model: Joint delivery: accredited implementation partner leads, with Redington architecture and commercial governance; the customer owns pricing policy, legal clearance and every approval decision · Duration: 8–12 weeks pilot; further 16–26 weeks to enterprise scale
Delivery pod: Partner delivery lead + project manager, pricing data scientist, integration engineer; customer category merchant, pricing owner, finance reviewer, legal reviewer, pricing-engine administrator · Support model: Business-hours or 24×7 option; severity-based response targets; partner service desk with vendor escalation
1) Discovery, cost-file validation and contribution baseline
2) Commercial data-layer build and elasticity estimation
3) Legal and margin guardrail configuration
4) Scenario back-test against the incumbent promotion calendar
5) Controlled category pilot with test and control groups
6) Benefit review, audit sampling and handover
deliverables: Baseline and elasticity estimates validated against held-out history
Legal and margin guardrails demonstrated to block prohibited actions
Scenario back-test beats the incumbent calendar on the agreed contribution measure
Approved actions reconcile line-for-line with the pricing engine
Controlled test readout confirmed by finance with the audit sample complete
effort: 8–12 weeks pilot; further 16–26 weeks to enterprise scale
languages: English delivery; Arabic product hierarchies, price labels and promotion mechanics supported
